method: Independent native source/test assertions, current SHA256 and retained exact RTK stdout/completion receipt review; no test rerun
sourceFindings: Real filesystem fixtures cover broken symlink owner identity, EACCES, deletion watcher invalidations, deleted draft copy/close and preservation of clean/dirty metadata.
Relocation preparation uses a native picker-selected path. No external file grant exists until confirmed association; only the selected file is granted.
Apply checks candidate disk revision, source editor/document/checkpoint identity, project epoch and digest before association.

keepBuffer retains full checkpoint text beyond truncated comparison preview, native document identity/revision/encoding/EOL and selection; restart reads the same persisted draft; target changes only on explicit later save.
useSelected loads full candidate before replacing native state and removing the old checkpoint; readonly complete text is accepted with source/target bytes and 0444 mode unchanged.
keepBuffer still rejects noneditable candidates; incomplete or unsupported candidates cannot replace a dirty buffer.
provenanceLimits: 10 file_recovery and 33 files_workflow passes refer to earlier source hashes in report.previousSourceHashes; final correction has seven relocation passes and four filtered tests, not eleven newly executed passes.

Exact RTK stdout and completed tool results are retained and independently matched. Unfiltered Cargo logs and absolute start/completion timestamps were not retained; no timings are inferred from poll wall_time_seconds.
No native application build/restart/picker/UI acceptance is claimed by these dispatch/filesystem tests.
